conversions.name: resonate_grid_crystal
conversions.why: The resonator turns one redstone dust into one grid crystal using Grid Power, which has no EMC (a custom recipe type the EMC mods cannot map).

recipe_processes.name: resonating
recipe_processes.why: Every resonating recipe, including datapack additions, must not create EMC: Grid Power is free once built, so a recipe worth more out than in would be an infinite EMC loop.

notes: Generators turn items into Forge Energy / Team Reborn Energy, not items, so they need no EMC process. Grid Power is a rate shared per player or team and is never stored in an item. The quantum quarry, ender quarry and mechanical miner/user make no new item kinds: they yield ordinary blocks and their vanilla loot (already valued by the EMC mods) at a rate bounded by Grid Power or energy, so they need no EMC process either. The quantum quarry's table is about 2.5% ore at 0.5 blocks/s base (5 blocks/s with eight speed upgrades for 160 GP), so it is a slow ore source, not an EMC fountain. The phase 2d mills, rainbow generator and power converter turn fire, lava, player effort, a dragon egg, running generators or energy into GP or energy, never into items, so they need none either.
